description.value: Miniature World is a long-running indoor attraction located inside the iconic Fairmont Empress Hotel on Victoria's Inner Harbour, featuring over 85 detailed miniature dioramas spanning history, fantasy, and science fiction. Highlights include the world's smallest operational sawmill, one of the world's largest model railways depicting Canada's 1880s transcontinental rail build, and two enormous Victorian-era dollhouses with over 50 furnished rooms. Having operated for more than 50 years, it draws visitors of all ages and sits in one of downtown Victoria's most walkable and bikeable districts.
